values.description: Base URL of the BACKUP EAGLE REST API, including the /api/rest path prefix. Update host and port to match your BACKUP EAGLE server. The server uses a self-signed certificate by default, so disable SSL certificate verification in Postman's settings when testing against localhost.

BACKUP EAGLE username used for HTTP Basic Auth. Most endpoints require the 'admin' role; some read-only endpoints also accept 'analyst', 'ca_admin', or 'ca_access' - see the request description or the REST API manual for the exact roles allowed per endpoint.
Password of the BACKUP EAGLE user set in 'username', used for HTTP Basic Auth.
